{{Otheruses|Kessel}}
[[File:AttackOfTheEnergySpider-GlitterStimMines.jpg|250px|thumb|An inmate being attacked by an [[energy spider]]]]
{{Quote|We'll be sent to the spice mines of Kessel, smashed into who-knows-what!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''spice mines of Kessel''' were known as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prison and later as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camp.

==Description==
It was filled with dangerous [[energy spider]]s that constantly attacked the workers who mined the precious [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. It was known as a form of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], as the work was so difficult and the conditions so poor. The mines were extremely cold, so much so that thermal suits had to be worn to keep the workers alive. Because of the weak atmosphere, essential gases such as oxygen were constantly escaping. Oxygen generators were stationed around the planet. The Empire threatened to sentence beings who would not cooperate to work in the mines if these beings continued to ignore them.

==History==
Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hawk Carrow]] and [[Nagraoao]] were prisoners in the Spice Mines of Kessel. [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] took his ship, the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', to the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] to rescue his friends, but was stopped by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] for inspection. Garnet bribed a Navy officer to let him go.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

Before [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] died and the Empire started to fall, there was a prison coup in which the assistant to the warden took over and turned the mines into his own slave encampment. Eventually [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] attempted to turn the mines into a [[Calrissian-Nunb Mines|legitimate operation]]. The mines were also where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] discovered [[Kyp Durron]].
